pastor.description: A staff member's role, shown over their name on the site and offered in the admin's editor: the pastor of the church.

elder.description: A staff member's role, shown over their name on the site and offered in the admin's editor: one of the church's elders.

staff.description: A staff member's role, shown over their name on the site and offered in the admin's editor: someone who serves the church in another capacity, such as in its office.
